recapCommandDescription.zh-CN: 为当前会话生成一段简短回顾
recapCommandDescription.en-US: Generate a short recap of the current session

codexResetsCommandDescription.zh-CN: 查看并兑换已积累的 OpenAI Codex 速率限制重置
codexResetsCommandDescription.en-US: Browse and redeem banked OpenAI Codex rate-limit resets

presetNoApiKey.zh-CN: 预设 {key}：{model} 没有 API key

presetThinkingClamped.zh-CN: 预设 {key}：思考级别 {requested} 被限制为 {applied}
presetThinkingClamped.en-US: Preset {key}: thinking level {requested} was clamped to {applied}

noCodexResets.zh-CN: 没有可用的 Codex 重置

codexResetsNoDetails.en-US: {resets}, but no reset details were returned

codexPanelTitle.zh-CN: OpenAI Codex 已积累的速率限制重置

codexRedeemWarning.zh-CN: 此操作会永久消耗一次已积累重置，并重置所有符合条件的窗口。
codexRedeemWarning.en-US: This permanently consumes one banked reset and resets all eligible windows.

codexBankedResetDefault.zh-CN: 已积累的速率限制重置

metricsConfigUsage.zh-CN: 用法：/config:metrics（打开配置菜单）、enable、disable、live、on-stop 或 reset
metricsConfigUsage.en-US: Usage: /config:metrics (open settings), enable, disable, live, on-stop, or reset

metricsConfigInteractiveOnly.zh-CN: 指标配置需要在 TUI 中修改；请在交互式 Pi 会话中执行命令。
metricsConfigInteractiveOnly.en-US: Metrics configuration requires the TUI; run this command in an interactive Pi session.

metricsConfigSaved.zh-CN: 指标配置已保存：{path}。下一轮运行生效。
metricsConfigSaved.en-US: Metrics configuration saved to {path}. It applies on the next run.

metricsProjectOverride.zh-CN: 当前项目的 spark.json 也设置了 metrics，会覆盖这份全局配置。
metricsProjectOverride.en-US: The project spark.json also sets metrics and overrides this global configuration.

resourcesCommandDescription.zh-CN: 管理 # 会话资源选择器

resourcesConfigLoadFailed.zh-CN: 会话资源配置读取失败：{path}（{error}）。当前使用启用状态。
resourcesConfigLoadFailed.en-US: Failed to read session resource configuration: {path} ({error}). The picker remains enabled.

resourcesConfigSaveFailed.zh-CN: 会话资源配置保存失败：{path}（{error}）。
resourcesConfigSaveFailed.en-US: Failed to save session resource configuration: {path} ({error}).

resourcesReferenceHint.zh-CN: 在输入框键入 # 并继续输入即可筛选会话资源；←/→ 或 Tab/Shift+Tab 切换类型，↑/↓ 选择，Enter 插入引用
resourcesReferenceHint.en-US: Type # in the editor and continue typing to filter session resources; Left/Right or Tab/Shift+Tab switch types, Up/Down selects, and Enter inserts the reference

resourcesReferenceDisabledHint.zh-CN: # 会话资源选择器当前已禁用；使用 /config:session-resources enable 启用
resourcesReferenceDisabledHint.en-US: The # session resource picker is disabled; use /config:session-resources enable to enable it

resourcesEnabled.zh-CN: # 会话资源选择器已启用

resourcesDisabled.zh-CN: # 会话资源选择器已禁用

resourcesPickerNoMatches.zh-CN: 当前类型没有匹配的资源
resourcesPickerNoMatches.en-US: No matching resources in this type

resourcesPickerHint.zh-CN: ←/→ 或 Tab/Shift+Tab 切换类型 · ↑/↓ 选择 · Enter 插入 · Esc 返回
resourcesPickerHint.en-US: Left/Right or Tab/Shift+Tab type · Up/Down select · Enter insert · Esc close

resourcesPickerHintMouse.zh-CN: ←/→ 类型 · ↑/↓ 选择 · 点击打开

resourcesProjectOverride.zh-CN: 当前项目的 spark.json 也设置了 resources，会覆盖这份全局配置。
resourcesProjectOverride.en-US: The project spark.json also sets resources and overrides this global configuration.

cleanModeToggleGroupsDescription.zh-CN: 清爽模式：展开或收起全部动作组
cleanModeToggleGroupsDescription.en-US: Clean mode: expand or collapse all action groups

cleanModeGroupsExpandedNotice.zh-CN: 清爽模式：已展开全部动作组，按 {key} 收起
cleanModeGroupsExpandedNotice.en-US: Clean mode: all action groups expanded, press {key} to collapse

cleanModeGroupsCollapsedNotice.zh-CN: 清爽模式：已收起全部动作组，按 {key} 展开
cleanModeGroupsCollapsedNotice.en-US: Clean mode: all action groups collapsed, press {key} to expand

cleanModeToggleDescription.zh-CN: 清爽模式：收起或展开本轮工作过程
cleanModeToggleDescription.en-US: Clean mode: collapse or expand this run's work

cleanModeConfigDescription.zh-CN: 清爽模式：打开配置面板，或直接写 key=on/off
cleanModeConfigDescription.en-US: Clean mode: open the settings panel, or pass key=on/off

cleanModeConfigDescEnabled.zh-CN: 关闭后完全按 Pi 的原始方式渲染，不再折叠任何内容
cleanModeConfigDescEnabled.en-US: When off, Pi renders tool output exactly as it does by default

cleanModeConfigDescShowRunHeader.zh-CN: 收起后在最终答案上方显示「用时 Ns · N 步」
cleanModeConfigDescShowRunHeader.en-US: Show "Took Ns · N steps" above the final answer when collapsed

cleanModeConfigDescAutoExpand.zh-CN: 运行过程中显示工作过程，运行结束后自动收起
cleanModeConfigDescAutoExpand.en-US: Show work while the run is active and collapse it when the run settles

cleanModeConfigDescActionGroups.zh-CN: 把同一轮的多条工具调用收成一行组头
cleanModeConfigDescActionGroups.en-US: Collapse a turn's tool calls into a single group header

cleanModeConfigDescActivityArea.zh-CN: 运行中在整轮最上方显示「现在在做什么」
cleanModeConfigDescActivityArea.en-US: Show what is running at the top of the current run

cleanModeConfigDescActivityRows.zh-CN: 活动区最多占用的行数；回车后选择具体数字
cleanModeConfigDescActivityRows.en-US: Maximum rows used by the activity area; press enter to pick a number

cleanModeConfigDescAnimateActivity.zh-CN: 关闭后活动区只显示静止标记
cleanModeConfigDescAnimateActivity.en-US: When off, the activity area shows a static marker

cleanModeConfigDescHideThinking.zh-CN: 收起模型的思考原文，只保留结论
cleanModeConfigDescHideThinking.en-US: Strip the model's reasoning text and keep conclusions

cleanModeConfigDescHideExtensionEntries.zh-CN: 折叠时把扩展写入的条目（如 distill 审计行）一并收起；info 级通知也跟着收，警告与错误仍可见
cleanModeConfigDescHideExtensionEntries.en-US: Also collapse custom entries written by extensions (e.g. distill audit rows); info notices collapse too, warnings and errors stay visible

cleanModeCollapsedNotice.zh-CN: 清爽模式：已收起工作过程，按 {key} 展开
cleanModeCollapsedNotice.en-US: Clean mode: work collapsed, press {key} to expand

cleanModeExpandedNotice.zh-CN: 清爽模式：已展开工作过程，按 {key} 收起
cleanModeExpandedNotice.en-US: Clean mode: work expanded, press {key} to collapse

cleanModeConfigSaveFailed.zh-CN: 清爽模式配置保存失败：{error}
cleanModeConfigSaveFailed.en-US: Failed to save clean mode configuration: {error}

cleanModeLoadFailed.zh-CN: 清爽模式配置读取失败，已使用默认值：{error}
cleanModeLoadFailed.en-US: Failed to read clean mode configuration, using defaults: {error}

cleanModeNotTuiMode.zh-CN: 清爽模式仅在交互式 TUI 下生效
cleanModeNotTuiMode.en-US: Clean mode only applies in interactive TUI mode
